Look up display labels for known ACE grouping columns

label_lookup.Rd

Internal helper returning a named lookup vector for columns with package-defined display names, or NULL if var_name has no lookup (in which case callers should fall back to default labelling).

Usage

label_lookup(var_name, abbreviate_flags = FALSE)

Arguments

var_name

String. Column name, e.g. "GEAR_CODE".

abbreviate_flags

Logical. Abbreviates the flag names (useful for plotting purposes).

Value

A named character vector, or NULL.
